title: At the library
instructions: Can kütüphaneye üye oluyor ve kitap alıyor. Kaç kitap alabileceğine ve iade gününe dikkat et.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Hello. I want to borrow some books. Can I join the library?

script.speaker: librarian
script.text: Yes, of course. Can I see your ID card, please?

script.speaker: librarian
script.text: Thank you. And what is your address?

script.speaker: librarian
script.text: OK. Here is your library card. You can borrow four books at a time.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Great. I want these three books.

script.speaker: librarian
script.text: Fine. Please bring them back in two weeks.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Is the library open on Sundays?

script.speaker: librarian
script.text: No, it isn't. We're open from Monday to Saturday.

questions.prompt: What does the librarian want to see?
questions.feedback: Görevli kimlik kartını (ID card) görmek istiyor.
questions.evidence: Can I see your ID card, please?

questions.prompt: How many books can Can borrow at a time?
questions.feedback: Bir seferde dört (four) kitap alabilir. Bugün üç tane alıyor; on dört adres numarası.
questions.evidence: You can borrow four books at a time.

questions.prompt: When must Can bring the books back?
questions.feedback: Kitapları iki hafta içinde (in two weeks) getirmeli.
questions.evidence: Please bring them back in two weeks.

questions.feedback: Kütüphane pazartesiden cumartesiye açık; pazar (Sunday) kapalı.
questions.evidence: No, it isn't. We're open from Monday to Saturday.
